answers.reason: The senate is a central university body, whereas this representative was elected for a single faculty and takes part only in their one designated faculty body.
Budget allocation is a central administrative matter outside the student representative's single area of participation.
Professorial appointments are separate from student representation, and members only sit in the one body dedicated to their matters.
Because each member participates in only one body and study matters are handled specifically in the study commission, the student representative does not also sit in the faculty council.
Speaking for the faculty's students on degree programmes and teaching is the primary matter of the elected student representative, making this their single place of participation.
The examination board handles administrative decisions on individual student cases rather than general student representation, and members only belong to one body.
Internal research funding does not concern student representation, and members do not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
The student representative is limited to one body for their matters, which is the study commission rather than this specific working group.
Laboratory equipment procurement is treated as completely separate from study programmes and student representation.
Each member participates in only one place where their matters are decided, which for the elected faculty representative is the formal study commission rather than orientation planning.
